mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 14.5% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing the probability of a near-term recession and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of stagflation and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 92.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03 in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 255.0 over a one-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,200,000 units signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 1200.0 fails to predict positive SPX 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that may force the Fed to tighten policy, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200000 and UNRATE < 14.8 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 18,900 billion dollars over a four-quarter window signals a recessionary trend, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during GDPC1 < 18900 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03 in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.
